scope: Six authored/typing changes and two new concepts only; 74 compatible-reuse/context decisions remain outside N2. Preview dossiers are not deployed documentation.

relation_vocabulary.RELATED: Selected external context is relevant; no equivalence asserted.
relation_vocabulary.CONTRAST: A useful explicit difference in meaning or role.
relation_vocabulary.ANALOGY: A selected resemblance with different commitments or participants.

prov.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology

role.version: Unversioned latest documentation; response body hash and access date retained
role.inspection_scope: Definition and constraints C1-C2 only; modeling foundation, not a domain definition.

entity.name: prov:Entity
entity.paraphrase: A thing considered through fixed aspects, including conceptual or imaginary things.

person.name: prov:Person
person.paraphrase: A person considered as a provenance agent.

org.name: prov:Organization
org.paraphrase: A social or legal institution considered as an agent.

revision.name: prov:Revision
revision.paraphrase: A qualified derivation whose result revises an original while retaining substantial content.

role.name: prov:Role
role.paraphrase: A function in an activity-qualified provenance context.

usage.name: prov:Usage
usage.paraphrase: Qualified use of an entity by an activity.

qualified_usage.paraphrase: Connects an activity to its usage qualification.

ontouml_role.name: OntoUML Role
ontouml_role.paraphrase: A contingent, relationally dependent sortal that inherits identity.

ontouml_relator.name: OntoUML Relator
ontouml_relator.paraphrase: An identity-bearing objectification of a relationship; mediation minima total at least two.

concepts.title: Information Artifact
concepts.authored_definition: A managed documentary object with an instituted identity that persists across its descriptions and issued versions. Artifact identity is distinct from a file path, a storage row and semantic content.
concepts.rationale: Retain the documentary comparison. Riskium adds continuity across descriptions and issued versions; the revised typing rationale separates documentary institution from RiskCase approval. No universal admission rule follows.

illustrations.positive: One managed risk policy survives replacement of its file and issue of a new version.
illustrations.counterexample: A copied file path or storage row alone does not establish a second artifact identity.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Artifact Version
concepts.authored_definition: An identifiable issued documentary version of a managed information artifact. Its issued semantic content and effective dependency versions are immutable; revisions receive distinct version identities.
concepts.rationale: Retain the distinction: the issued version is the documentary object; Revision qualifies a derivation. First issue need not revise a predecessor. Issuance policy does not determine whether a RiskCase exists.

illustrations.positive: A correction is issued as a separately identified version with explicit predecessor lineage.
illustrations.counterexample: A revision relationship must not be substituted for the resulting version object.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Person
concepts.authored_definition: A human individual who may participate in risk management activities or assignments.
concepts.rationale: Retain a human-agent comparison without adopting external identity or typing axioms. Riskium preserves the person identity owned by the external domain; participation and a responsibility mandate need separate evidence.

illustrations.positive: The same externally identified person participates in two analyses without being duplicated.
illustrations.counterexample: An owner name in an imported document alone does not establish authority or a grounded assignment.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Organization
concepts.authored_definition: An organized social entity capable of carrying responsibilities and authorizations in the model's scope.
concepts.rationale: Retain an institutional-agent comparison. Capacity to carry responsibilities is distinct from a demonstrated mandate. Organization identity does not require local register approval of every analytical RiskCase.

illustrations.positive: A supplier organization is referenced by its external identity in an ecosystem analysis.
illustrations.counterexample: An organization record alone does not establish a responsibility relator or actual authorization.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Evidence Item
concepts.authored_definition: An information artifact playing an evidential role for a specified claim or analytical activity. The same artifact may be used as evidence in one context and not another.
concepts.rationale: Retain the external comparison and separately document the role foundation. EvidenceItem inherits artifact identity; RE-001 makes participation depend on grounded use. It does not classify every artifact as evidence everywhere.

illustrations.positive: A retained report plays an evidential role in one grounded analysis and remains the same artifact afterwards.
illustrations.counterexample: A bibliography mention alone does not establish actual evidential participation or claim truth.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Risk Case
concepts.authored_definition: An identifiable risk item for analysis and tracking in relation to objectives and context, which may represent a threat or opportunity from a specified perspective. Its identity persists across descriptions, assessments and administrative record states. It is distinct from a register entry, scenario specification and actual occurrence. Formal organizational register acceptance is application-specific, not a general condition for its existence.
concepts.rationale: Replace the old scoped absence label with an explicit comparison boundary. RiskCase is the continuing analytical item for objectives and context, including threat or opportunity perspectives. A generic Entity comparison does not supply its continuity rule. Register admission remains a local application policy. This disposition makes no novelty or universal absence claim.

illustrations.positive: One analytical risk item is tracked before register admission and later described by several entries.
illustrations.counterexample: Equal labels, equal scores or missing organizational approval do not by themselves decide case identity.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Evidence Use Relator
concepts.authored_definition: A context-qualified evidential-use relationship connecting a qualified reference and a distinct information artifact used as support, challenge or context in an analysis. Its grounding concerns that use, not the truth of the referenced claim.
concepts.rationale: Use an analogy to provenance usage while preserving the different participant structure. Riskium objectifies a grounded use linking a qualified reference and an evidence artifact, with context and purpose. RE-001 and RE-002 mediate the participants; RE-003 records grounding. OntoUML C2 supplies a minimum-count rule; distinct participants are an additional Riskium C-26 commitment, not a conclusion from that sum.

illustrations.positive: A documented analysis uses a particular report as support through a distinct qualified reference and a grounding record.
illustrations.counterexample: A proposed citation without grounded use is information; reusing one individual at both mediated ends violates Riskium C-26.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Evidence Reference Role
concepts.authored_definition: A qualified EvidenceReference participating in an actual grounded evidential-use relationship. The reference retains documentary identity when it is only a record of a proposed use.
concepts.rationale: Distinguish a function description from the documentary reference that participates in grounded use. GE-001 preserves reference identity through EvidenceReference and InformationArtifact; RE-002 supplies the role dependency. The reference can exist as a record of proposed use without this role membership.

illustrations.positive: An existing qualified reference participates in an actual grounded use while keeping its documentary identity.
illustrations.counterexample: Assigning a PROV function label or recording a proposed use alone does not instantiate this participation role.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

boundaries.source_status_policy: Preserve historical verification_status strings verbatim. Read actual bounded qualification/publication receipts separately; no independent semantic acceptance is inferred.
boundaries.normative_crosswalks: Exact PRINCE2/ISACA/ISO term or clause adoption remains #78; this packet does not claim inspection of their licensed normative text.
boundaries.independent_review: Existing #23 remains separate; source comparisons are not independent ratings.
boundaries.full_component: Historical curation 0.1.0 is unchanged; a complete successor component is not created by this eight-row packet.
